lines: In 2004, Blockbuster had over nine thousand stores.
It started in 1985, with a single store in Dallas, Texas.
Then it spread across America, one store at a time.
In 2000, a tiny DVD-by-mail startup offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for fifty million dollars.

Blockbuster said no. That startup was Netflix.
Netflix moved to streaming. Blockbuster kept renting discs.
And today, the last one stands in Bend, Oregon.
